hero.description: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about Vistara's services, pricing, technical aspects, and support.
hero.visualTitle:
We Are Ready
To Help You

q1.question: What services does Vistara provide?
q1.answer: Vistara provides a range of information technology services including web and mobile app development, IT consulting, digital transformation, e-commerce platform development, and cloud-based business solutions. We serve projects of all sizes, from startups to enterprise companies.

q2.question: How do I start working with Vistara?
q2.answer: You can start by contacting our team through the contact page or by emailing vistarateknologiindonesia@gmail.com. Our team will schedule a free initial consultation to understand your business needs, then prepare a proposal aligned with your project goals and budget.

q3.question: Does Vistara accept small-scale projects?
q3.answer: Yes, we accept projects of all sizes. We understand that every business has different needs. Our team will tailor the solution and approach to your project's scale and complexity, including small and medium-sized projects.

q4.question: How does pricing work at Vistara?
q4.answer: We offer several flexible pricing models: project-based (fixed project price), time-based (per hour or per month), and retainer (monthly subscription for ongoing support). Pricing is adjusted based on complexity, duration, and scope. Contact us for the right quote.

q5.question: Is a free consultation available before starting a project?
q5.answer: Yes, we provide a free initial consultation lasting 30-60 minutes. During this session, our team will listen to your needs, provide a suitable solution overview, and give an initial cost estimate. There is no obligation to proceed after the consultation.

q6.question: Are installment payment options available?
q6.answer: Yes, for larger projects we provide milestone-based installment payments. Payments are typically split into 3-4 stages based on work progress. Payment details will be included in the contract agreement.

q7.question: What technologies does Vistara use?
q7.answer: Vistara uses modern technologies including React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, and cloud infrastructure from AWS, GCP, and Azure. We choose the most suitable technology for your project to achieve optimal results.

q8.question: How does Vistara protect client data?
q8.answer: Data security is our top priority. We apply high security standards including end-to-end encryption, multi-factor authentication, regular security audits, penetration testing, and compliance with ISO 27001 and applicable data protection regulations.

q9.question: Does Vistara provide system migration services?
q9.answer: Yes, we provide system migration services from legacy platforms to new platforms. Our team will perform a thorough analysis of the existing system, plan a low-risk migration strategy, and ensure a smooth transition without significant operational disruption.

q10.question: How can I contact Vistara technical support?
q10.answer: You can contact our technical support via email at support@vistara.co.id, by phone at +62 21 5555 0123, or through the ticketing portal available to clients. Our support team operates on weekdays, Monday through Friday, from 09:00 to 18:00 WIB.

q11.question: Does Vistara provide post-launch maintenance services?
q11.answer: Yes, we provide post-launch maintenance and support services including performance monitoring, bug fixes, security updates, and new feature development. We offer SLA packages with customized response levels.

q12.question: How long is the response time for support tickets?
q12.answer: Our response times vary by priority: Critical (1 hour), High (4 hours), Medium (1 business day), and Low (3 business days). Clients on premium SLA packages receive faster response priority and direct access to senior technical staff.

hero.description: This policy explains how PT. Vistara Teknologi Indonesia uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit and use our website.

sidebar.title: Table of Contents
sidebar.questionText: If you have questions about our cookies policy, feel free to contact us.

section1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or phone) when you visit a website. Cookies are generally used so websites can recognize a user's device and remember certain information about previous visits.
section1.p2: Cookies help us provide a better browsing experience, understand how visitors interact with our site, and improve the quality of our services. The cookies we use do not store directly identifiable information.

section2.intro: We use different types of cookies for different purposes. Here are the categories we use:

essential.title: Essential
essential.description: Cookies required for the website to function properly. These cookies cannot be disabled because they are part of how our service works.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Cookies that let the website remember choices you make, such as language, region, or display settings, to provide a more personalized experience.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Cookies that collect information about how visitors use the website, such as the most visited pages and server response times, to help us improve site performance.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Cookies used to track visitor activity across websites. The goal is to show relevant and engaging ads to individual users.

reasons.ensureFunction: Ensuring the website works properly and meets user expectations.
reasons.rememberPreferences: Remembering the preferences and settings you selected.
reasons.analyzeTraffic: Analyzing traffic and usage patterns to improve service quality.
reasons.relevantContent: Providing content and ads relevant to your interests.
reasons.security: Protecting account security and preventing abuse.

section3.intro: We use cookies for several purposes, including:

section4.p1: You have the right to control cookie usage. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Most browsers let you block or delete cookies from specific sites or from all sites.
section4.p2: Please note that disabling or blocking certain cookies may affect functionality and your experience when using our website. Some features may not work properly if cookies are disabled.

section5.p1: Our website may use third-party cookies provided by analytics services such as Google Analytics. These third-party cookies help us analyze web traffic and understand how visitors use our site.
section5.p2: Information collected by third-party cookies is sent to and stored by their respective providers according to their privacy policies. We recommend reading the privacy policies of those third-party providers to understand how they manage data.

section6.intro: If you have questions, complaints, or requests related to this Cookies Policy, please contact us through the following channels:
